_meta.description: Waymarking.com-style entries along the corridor. Waymarking has no public REST API, so this is a small manual import. Add more by browsing categories on waymarking.com.

entries.name: Colorado National Monument Visitor Center
entries.blurb: Sandstone cliff overlooks; short walks suitable for dogs on leash.

entries.name: Pony Express Marker — Kearney County
entries.blurb: Historical marker waymark for the old Pony Express trail.

entries.name: Wamego Oz Museum
entries.blurb: Yellow brick road photo op; surprisingly deep Oz collection.

entries.name: Harry S. Truman Presidential Library
entries.blurb: Presidential library waymark; Truman is buried here.

entries.name: Gateway Arch
entries.blurb: If detouring south; obvious but tram to the top is genuinely fun.

entries.name: Flight 93 National Memorial
entries.blurb: Solemn memorial near the Pittsburgh approach.
